subject: general
question:
The following bar graph shows the monthly incomes (in thousand rupees) of Aman, Suman and Jyoti in six consecutive years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db2d8f07611ccbde1c1d439f99452a2e40f013ee0b512bc764260afcbfc9a1b0.png] 

What was the difference between the average monthly income of Jyoti over all the six years taken together and Aman’s monthly income in the year 2006?
solution:
**Calculation:**

According to the question:

Average monthly income of Jyoti over the six-year

(9000 + 11000 + 18000 + 27000 + 26000 + 35000)/6 = 21000

Aman’s monthly income in the year 2006 = 18000

Difference = 21000 - 18000 = 3000

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
